text:
jess: heads-up — the runtime examples guide has a broken image and an outdated curl snippet that hits the old /v1/generate endpoint. noticed from a customer slack thread. screenshot + failing curl pasted below. :frowning:

owen: can you drop the file path and the curl you used?

jess: repro: `curl -sS https://internal.kb/search?q=runtime+examples | grep -i examples -A1` shows the guide at `/guides/runtime/examples` mapping to content/kb/runtime/examples.md. inside that page the snippet is:```bash
curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
``` which 404s (we've deprecated /v1/generate). image `assets/arch-diagram.png` returns 404 too.

nina: thanks. docs-bot weekly scan also flagged sample-outdated and asset-404 a few hours ago (KB-550). assigning to docs queue.

tim: short plan: 1) update curl snippet to use `/v1/text/generate` and add note about new API shape; 2) rehost the image under `static/images/runtime/arch-v2.png` and update path; 3) run local markdown render and a quick smoke curl to verify. i'll open the PR and include KB-550.

owen: please include the exact snippet change in the PR description so deploy-lint picks it up. also run `npm run docs:build` locally to catch render errors.

jess: also grep for other occurrences of `/v1/generate` so we don't miss another sample: `git grep "/v1/generate" -- docs/ content/`.

tim: will do. PR opened: https://git.internal/repo/pull/2333 — title: "docs(kb): update runtime examples curl + rehost arch image". PR body references KB-550 and includes the changed snippet:```diff
- curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hi"}'
+ curl https://api.redwood.ai/v1/text/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"hi"}'
```

nina: small nit — add a one-line changelog in the guide (Under "Changelog") that mentions the endpoint rename so customers searching history see intent.

tim: added changelog line in the PR diff and a short note crediting the customer report. cc @owen for review. CI triggered.

owen: reviewing now. also check the image alt text; we prefer descriptive alt (e.g., "Runtime architecture v2, showing cache and routing").

tim: updated alt text and pushed. CI green.

nina: LGTM, small doc-owner signature added. merging.

jess: thanks — verified local build and ran the updated curl test: `curl -sS -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/text/generate -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"input":"test"}' | jq .` returns 200 and content. image resolves.

docs-bot: Automated note: KB-550 tracked issue updated. will auto-close when next weekly scan shows no matches for `/v1/generate` in the KB and asset 404 cleared.

owen: i'll run a repo-wide grep for `/v1/generate` and queue a follow-up if any hits remain. thanks for the fast turn-around team. :rocket:
